clause: Alignment aids: ruler guides, distance measure, object snapping, pixel grid, tidy-up/smart-distribute [STU-DS-047e]

scope.summary: Implement the alignment aids that are part of the layout surface but are not StudioLayoutGrid overlays: canvas- and frame-scoped ruler guides that snap objects during moves and clear per scope; live alt-hover distance measurement between objects and frame edges; object snapping with transient alignment lines and equal-spacing badges; a pixel grid visible at high zoom with a snap-to-pixel preference; and a tidy-up / smart-selection command that evenly distributes a rough selection into a row/column/grid with draggable spacing handles.
acceptance_criteria: ruler guides + distance measure + snapping + pixel grid + tidy-up; author_ids + manual entry
expected_tests: argus: ruler guides, snapping, pixel grid, tidy-up reachable via author_ids
test: guides snap + clear per scope; alt-hover distance readout; alignment lines + equal-spacing badges; snap-to-pixel; tidy-up distributes into row/col/grid

target_entries: Studio / Design Systems / Guides, snapping and tidy-up

risk_if_missed: No ruler guides/snapping/tidy-up; precise alignment work impossible.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
